**07:00** – **Priya Sharma**
Will do. I'm heading out after the morning meeting. Might need access to the relay room – can someone confirm the key is available?

**07:05** – **Mark O'Brien**
Key's in the usual spot at the TS14 depot, I left it there last week after the fault finding on the points. Should be with the other spares.

**07:30** – **Lara Thompson**
Copy. Also, for anyone working near the heritage precinct – there's an open day at the old station on Sunday. Not our issue, but keep the area tidy and watch for visitors.

**08:00** – **James Wilson (Operations Supervisor)**
Morning all. Just a heads up – the 07:52 up service ran a bit hot approaching Ballarat because of the heat. No fault, just thermal speed restrictions in place. Crews to note the track temperature is already 42°C at the rail. Plan accordingly.

**08:15** – **Mark O'Brien**
Thanks James. We're monitoring the rail temp here – currently 44°C, so we'll hold off on any stressing work until it cools. Grinding is fine, just slower going.

**08:30** – **Lara Thompson**
A reminder on the speed restrictions: Section 12 and 14 are under 60 km/h from 11:00 until further notice due to forecast temps. This is per the heat policy. Update the boards.

**09:00** – **Priya Sharma**
At the relay room now. The track circuit at TS14 is showing a steady drop in resistance – looks like a bonding wire might be corroded near the bridge. Will inspect and replace if needed. WO-1190 raised.

**09:15** – **Mark O'Brien**
Good work Priya. The bonding on that bridge was on my list for next month, so glad you caught it early.

**09:30** – **Lara Thompson**
Keep me posted. Also, does anyone have the status on the drainage clearing at the culvert near TS12? That was scheduled for today.

**09:35** – **Mark O'Brien**
Crew C-3 cleared the culvert at 08:40. It was partially blocked with silt – took about an hour. All good now, just in time for the storms.

Ballarat Line line_opened 1889-04-17 date. Record status: historical.

**10:00** – **James Wilson**
Thanks for the update. The 09:52 down service reported a minor track circuit failure at the level crossing – but that was cleared by the time they passed. Priya, that might be related to the bonding issue.

**10:05** – **Priya Sharma**
Likely yes. I've replaced the bonding wire – should be stable now. I'll monitor it for the next hour.

**10:30** – **Lara Thompson**
Good. Now, on the heritage note – I saw a query from the historical society about the line's opening date. I think it was 17 April 1889, but can someone confirm from the records? They want it for a plaque.

**10:35** – **James Wilson**
That matches what I've seen in the archives. The line was opened on 17 April 1889. I'll send them the reference.

**10:40** – **Lara Thompson**
Thanks James. Appreciate it.

**11:00** – **Mark O'Brien**
Speed restriction boards are up at TS12. We're still grinding – about 400m left. Should be done by 13:00 as planned.

**11:30** – **Priya Sharma**
Track circuit at TS14 is stable now. I'll do a final check after the storm passes. Also, I noticed the points at the crossover are a bit stiff – might need lubrication next week.

**11:45** – **Lara Thompson**
Noted. I'll add that to the weekly plan.

**12:00** – **James Wilson**
Weather update – the storm cell is moving faster than expected. It'll hit the corridor around 13:30. All crews to secure loose items and move to shelter when it arrives.
**12:15** – **Lara Thompson**
Copy that. I'll alert the signal team about the earlier track circuit failure – they may want to check the interlocking logs. Also, the heritage society plaque – James, can you send me the archive reference so I can pass it along?

**12:20** – **James Wilson**
Will do. I'll dig it out after lunch and send it through.

**12:30** – **Priya Sharma**
Just a heads-up – I'm seeing some voltage fluctuation on the feed to the points heater at TS14. Probably not urgent, but I'll log it for the weekly check. Don't want it to become a problem before winter.

**12:45** – **Mark O'Brien**
Grinding's ahead of schedule. About 200m left, should be wrapped by 13:00. Crew C-3 will secure the site and head to the depot before the storm hits.

**13:00** – **Lara Thompson**
Good. Everyone – once the storm passes, we'll do a quick corridor check. Mark, can you have someone look at the drainage at the culvert again? If it was blocked before, it might be blocked again after heavy rain.

**13:05** – **Mark O'Brien**
Will do. I'll send one of the crew back out after the storm. Shouldn't take long.

**13:15** – **James Wilson**
Weather update – the storm cell is now overhead. Heavy rain and gusty winds up to 90 km/h. Crews should stay sheltered until it passes. Expected to clear by 15:00.

**13:30** – **Priya Sharma**
Understood. I'll hold off on the final track circuit check until the storm clears. The bonding wire replacement is holding up fine so far.

**13:45** – **Lara Thompson**
Thanks, Priya. Keep me posted.

**14:00** – **Mark O'Brien**
Storm's still going. Crews are all inside the depot. No issues reported.

**14:15** – **James Wilson**
The 14:05 down service reported a tree branch on the line near TS12 – but it's not blocking the track. Just a warning to crews to watch for debris when they head out.

**14:30** – **Lara Thompson**
Noted. Mark, add that to the check list.

**14:45** – **Mark O'Brien**
Done.

**15:00** – **James Wilson**
Storm cell has passed. Clearing conditions. I'll send an updated weather advisory shortly.

**15:05** – **Priya Sharma**
Good. I'll head out to do the final track circuit check at TS14 now. Should be done within the hour.

**15:15** – **Mark O'Brien**
Crew C-3 is heading back to the culvert to check the drainage. Should be there by 15:30.

**15:30** – **Lara Thompson**
Thanks, Mark. Once you've confirmed the drainage is clear, let me know. I want to close out the work order today if possible.

**15:45** – **Mark O'Brien**
Will do.

**16:00** – **Priya Sharma**
Track circuit at TS14 is stable. No issues. I'll log the final check.

**16:15** – **James Wilson**
Weather advisory – all clear. No further storms expected tonight. Normal operations can resume.

**16:30** – **Mark O'Brien**
Culvert drainage is clear. No blockages after the storm. WO-1187 can be closed out.

**16:35** – **Lara Thompson**
Excellent. I'll close out WO-1187 and update the log. Good work everyone.

**16:40** – **Priya Sharma**
Thanks all. I'll add the points lubrication to next week's plan.

**16:45** – **James Wilson**
Noted. I'll make sure it's on the schedule.

**16:50** – **Lara Thompson**
That's all for today. Handover notes will be sent to the night shift. Thanks for the quick response on the storm.

**17:00** – **Mark O'Brien**
👍

**17:05** – **Priya Sharma**
👍

**17:10** – **James Wilson**
👍

**17:15** – **Lara Thompson**
Good night, all.

**17:20** – **Mark O'Brien**
Night.

documents.content:
**07:00** – **Priya Sharma**
Will do. I'm heading out after the morning meeting. Might need access to the relay room – can someone confirm the key is available?

**07:05** – **Mark O'Brien**
Key's in the usual spot at the TS14 depot, I left it there last week after the fault finding on the points. Should be with the other spares.

**07:30** – **Lara Thompson**
Copy. Also, for anyone working near the heritage precinct – there's an open day at the old station on Sunday. Not our issue, but keep the area tidy and watch for visitors.

**08:00** – **James Wilson (Operations Supervisor)**
Morning all. Just a heads up – the 07:52 up service ran a bit hot approaching Ballarat because of the heat. No fault, just thermal speed restrictions in place. Crews to note the track temperature is already 42°C at the rail. Plan accordingly.

**08:15** – **Mark O'Brien**
Thanks James. We're monitoring the rail temp here – currently 44°C, so we'll hold off on any stressing work until it cools. Grinding is fine, just slower going.

**08:30** – **Lara Thompson**
A reminder on the speed restrictions: Section 12 and 14 are under 60 km/h from 11:00 until further notice due to forecast temps. This is per the heat policy. Update the boards.

**09:00** – **Priya Sharma**
At the relay room now. The track circuit at TS14 is showing a steady drop in resistance – looks like a bonding wire might be corroded near the bridge. Will inspect and replace if needed. WO-1190 raised.

**09:15** – **Mark O'Brien**
Good work Priya. The bonding on that bridge was on my list for next month, so glad you caught it early.

**09:30** – **Lara Thompson**
Keep me posted. Also, does anyone have the status on the drainage clearing at the culvert near TS12? That was scheduled for today.

**09:35** – **Mark O'Brien**
Crew C-3 cleared the culvert at 08:40. It was partially blocked with silt – took about an hour. All good now, just in time for the storms.

Ballarat Line line_opened 1889-04-17 date. Record status: historical.

**10:00** – **James Wilson**
Thanks for the update. The 09:52 down service reported a minor track circuit failure at the level crossing – but that was cleared by the time they passed. Priya, that might be related to the bonding issue.

**10:05** – **Priya Sharma**
Likely yes. I've replaced the bonding wire – should be stable now. I'll monitor it for the next hour.

**10:30** – **Lara Thompson**
Good. Now, on the heritage note – I saw a query from the historical society about the line's opening date. I think it was 17 April 1889, but can someone confirm from the records? They want it for a plaque.

**10:35** – **James Wilson**
That matches what I've seen in the archives. The line was opened on 17 April 1889. I'll send them the reference.

**10:40** – **Lara Thompson**
Thanks James. Appreciate it.

**11:00** – **Mark O'Brien**
Speed restriction boards are up at TS12. We're still grinding – about 400m left. Should be done by 13:00 as planned.

**11:30** – **Priya Sharma**
Track circuit at TS14 is stable now. I'll do a final check after the storm passes. Also, I noticed the points at the crossover are a bit stiff – might need lubrication next week.

**11:45** – **Lara Thompson**
Noted. I'll add that to the weekly plan.

**12:00** – **James Wilson**
Weather update – the storm cell is moving faster than expected. It'll hit the corridor around 13:30. All crews to secure loose items and move to shelter when it arrives.

documents.title: Ballarat Line Coordination – August 2026
documents.content:
**12:15** – **Lara Thompson**
Copy that. I'll alert the signal team about the earlier track circuit failure – they may want to check the interlocking logs. Also, the heritage society plaque – James, can you send me the archive reference so I can pass it along?

**12:20** – **James Wilson**
Will do. I'll dig it out after lunch and send it through.

**12:30** – **Priya Sharma**
Just a heads-up – I'm seeing some voltage fluctuation on the feed to the points heater at TS14. Probably not urgent, but I'll log it for the weekly check. Don't want it to become a problem before winter.

**12:45** – **Mark O'Brien**
Grinding's ahead of schedule. About 200m left, should be wrapped by 13:00. Crew C-3 will secure the site and head to the depot before the storm hits.

**13:00** – **Lara Thompson**
Good. Everyone – once the storm passes, we'll do a quick corridor check. Mark, can you have someone look at the drainage at the culvert again? If it was blocked before, it might be blocked again after heavy rain.

**13:05** – **Mark O'Brien**
Will do. I'll send one of the crew back out after the storm. Shouldn't take long.

**13:15** – **James Wilson**
Weather update – the storm cell is now overhead. Heavy rain and gusty winds up to 90 km/h. Crews should stay sheltered until it passes. Expected to clear by 15:00.

**13:30** – **Priya Sharma**
Understood. I'll hold off on the final track circuit check until the storm clears. The bonding wire replacement is holding up fine so far.

Thanks, Priya. Keep me posted.

Storm's still going. Crews are all inside the depot. No issues reported.

The 14:05 down service reported a tree branch on the line near TS12 – but it's not blocking the track. Just a warning to crews to watch for debris when they head out.

**14:30** – **Lara Thompson**
Noted. Mark, add that to the check list.

**14:45** – **Mark O'Brien**
Done.

**15:00** – **James Wilson**
Storm cell has passed. Clearing conditions. I'll send an updated weather advisory shortly.

Good. I'll head out to do the final track circuit check at TS14 now. Should be done within the hour.

Will do.

Track circuit at TS14 is stable. No issues. I'll log the final check.

Weather advisory – all clear. No further storms expected tonight. Normal operations can resume.

**16:30** – **Mark O'Brien**
Culvert drainage is clear. No blockages after the storm. WO-1187 can be closed out.

**16:35** – **Lara Thompson**
Excellent. I'll close out WO-1187 and update the log. Good work everyone.

**16:40** – **Priya Sharma**
Thanks all. I'll add the points lubrication to next week's plan.

**16:45** – **James Wilson**
Noted. I'll make sure it's on the schedule.

**16:50** – **Lara Thompson**
That's all for today. Handover notes will be sent to the night shift. Thanks for the quick response on the storm.

👍

👍

👍

Good night, all.

Night.

WORK ORDER WO-2026-1194
Task Type: Corrective – Signage
Location: Ballarat–Ararat corridor, level crossing LX-221 (km 42.3)
Scheduled Date: 13 August 2026
Assigned Crew: C-2
Equipment: Truck, hand tools, replacement signs
Status: Scheduled
Description: Replace missing advance warning sign (W2-2) on approach to LX-221, eastbound. Sign reported missing during routine patrol on 10 August. Post not damaged; bracket remains in place.
Notes: Replacement sign available from Ballarat depot stores (item code SIG-W2-2). Crew to photograph installation and record post condition. LX-221 is a passive crossing; no active controls affected.
Completion Notes: Pending.

---

WORK ORDER WO-2026-1195
Task Type: Preventive – Vegetation
Location: Ballarat–Wendouree corridor, km 11.0–14.0
Scheduled Date: 17–18 August 2026
Assigned Crew: C-5 (vegetation contractor)
Equipment: Brush cutter, chipper, hand tools
Status: Scheduled
Description: Cyclic vegetation clearing along both sides of formation. Priority on sighting distances at curves km 11.4, km 12.1, and km 13.6. Cut back to 3 m from rail centreline; remove fallen limbs within 5 m of formation edge.
Notes: Contractor to confirm access with Ballarat depot day before start. No herbicide use authorised without separate WO. Works to be suspended if wind exceeds 30 km/h during cutting operations.
Completion Notes: Pending.

---

WORK ORDER WO-2026-1196
Task Type: Corrective – Track Structure
Location: Ballarat yard, siding 4–6
Scheduled Date: 12 August 2026
Assigned Crew: C-3
Equipment: Hi-rail crane, ballast regulator, hand tools
Status: Completed
Description: Repair damaged rail joint at siding 4, turnout T-4. Joint bar cracked and one bolt sheared. Replace joint bar and bolts, re-torque to spec, and re-pad ballast around joint.
Notes: Defect identified during yard inspection 11 August. Rail seat abrasion noted at same location; no action required at this time but monitor at next inspection.
Completion Notes: Completed 12 August, 11:40. Joint replaced, bolts torqued to 900 N·m. Ballast restored. Siding returned to service 12:05. Follow-up inspection scheduled 19 August.

---

WORK ORDER WO-2026-1197
Task Type: Corrective – Level Crossing
Location: Ballarat–Geelong corridor, LX-208 (km 24.7)
Scheduled Date: 12 August 2026
Assigned Crew: C-1
Equipment: Roadworks crew, asphalt paver, roller, hand tools
Status: Completed
Description: Repair deteriorated road surface on both approaches to LX-208. Potholes and edge break-up reported by road authority 5 August. Works include milling and resurfacing of 20 m approach on each side.
Notes: Coordination with VicRoads required for traffic control. Works to be completed between 09:00 and 15:00. Flangeway clearance to be checked after surfacing.
Completion Notes: Completed 12 August, 14:50. Surface restored, flangeway clear at 65 mm. Traffic control removed. VicRoads notified of completion. No further action required.

---

WORK ORDER WO-2026-1198
Task Type: Preventive – Rail Lubrication
Location: Ballarat–Ararat corridor, curves km 35.0–37.5
Scheduled Date: 14 August 2026
Assigned Crew: C-4
Equipment: Lubrication unit, hand tools
Status: Scheduled
Description: Apply flange lubrication at curve sites km 35.2, km 36.0, and km 37.1. Check lubricator units for wear and refill reservoirs. Record rail wear at each site.
Notes: Last lubrication completed 9 July 2026 (WO-2026-0892). Rail wear measurements at km 35.2 recorded at 4 mm lateral wear; within limit. Units to be checked for clogged nozzles.
Completion Notes: Pending.
